title: Vegan Irish Fry-Up
description: A plant-based take on the traditional Irish breakfast, featuring sautéed vegetables and whole grains.

ingredients.name: stir-fry sauce (make your own or use store-bought vegan option)

instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for an additional 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tofu-based Irish sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Stir in the pitted dates and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Warm the whole wheat bread slices by toasting them in a toaster or under the broiler.
Serve the sautéed vegetables and sausages over the toasted bread, drizzled with stir-fry sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or chives, if desired.
